item.title: Scrap ‘Uncompetitive’ MediAsas, It’s Not A Game-Changer: Tanjong Karang MP
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Tanjong Karang MP Zulkafperi Hanapi wants MediAsas axed because it’s “not a game-changer”. Excluding pre-existing conditions means the sick/elderly might not be covered while MediAsas’ “uncompetitive” RM100,000 annual limit won’t attract the young/healthy. item.title: Vape Tax Collection Invalid If Liquid Nicotine Exemption Cancelled, MOF Said In 2023
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Johan Merican said in 2023 that cancelling the exemption of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List will invalidate vape tax collection. As Putrajaya now upholds a court ruling nullifying the exemption, it's unclear if it must refund vape businesses >RM354m.
